by: openlaw-1 session (Opus); to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of OpenLaw NZ's GraphQL `cases` list, as the lane's capture asked it (JSON)

landmarks: a JSON object {"data": {"cases": [...]}} with no top-level "errors"

every record is an object with a string `id`; the keys asked for are present (null allowed): caseName, caseDate, courtFilingNumber, location, court, pdf, caseCitations, casesCitedsByCaseOrigin, legislationToCases, experimentalPartyAndRepresentatives

signals_note: POST https://api.openlaw.nz/graphql with the lane's one query (registers/openlaw/capture.py, CASES_QUERY), cases(first: 10, offset: k, orderBy: [CASE_DATE_DESC, ID_DESC]), through the fetch gate; landed verbatim by hash. A JSON answer with `errors` is a failed read, not a page.
notes: The interface is PostGraphile: lists paged by first/offset, no total count (probe by offset). Ids are stable strings (e.g. acc_..._2001NZACC254.pdf). caseDate is a Date. The party table is the interface's own experimental extraction (partyType one of APPLICANT, PLAINTIFF, APPELLANT, RESPONDENT, DEFENDANT; names a list); counsel (`appearance`) is not asked for. `location` is the registry where the record names it. OpenLaw says some suppressed decisions are left out; an order made after publication is not seen. No model reads anything.
applies_to: OpenLaw NZ's interface, from 21 October 2026; held until OpenLaw authorises permanent copies (API terms 3.6(a))
process: Read pages newest landed first; a case read again on an older page is superseded, counted, not read twice.

One case row per record: the neutral citation ([YYYY] NZXX N) among caseCitations, court, registry (location, else the caption's 'X REGISTRY'), filing number, caseDate, the id, the PDF address; the title to the private twin.
Parties from the interface's party table, one row per name and role; where it has none, from the caption's BETWEEN/AND or 'R v NAME' grammar; never from the narrative.

A case is suppressed when its text or title carries a suppression or anonymisation marker, or a party is anonymised; then every non-Crown party's name and the title are withheld on every surface; the rows stay. An anonymised party is never expanded.
One citation row per casesCitedsByCaseOrigin entry (citing, cited, count); one statute row per legislationToCases entry (case, legislation, section, count, confidence).
gates: Every record of every page is a case row, a superseded record or a catch-log line (check.py).
No withheld name and no suppressed case's title appears on a view (check.py).
The held count of a finished full pass equals the interface's figure probed by offset at the pass's start (check.py).
